w3Mentions.name: The Redactor
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — The Redactor.

w3Mentions.name: Gavel
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. Gavel is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w3Mentions.name: Buffering
w3Mentions.firstLine: 💡 COUNTER LEARNED — Buffering: Stand still. It aims where you will be. Give it nothing to predict and it whiffs. (Gilberto lived to tell it, twice — the village pieced it together.)

w3Mentions.name: Ad Break
w3Mentions.firstLine: Something moves out there — Ad Break.

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: You settle into the hall floor. Sleep takes you.
Fever dreams shake you — wings, black water, a sky full of eyes. (-2 HP)
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
⚠ STARVING: health and energy falling. The spiral has started.
🌟 "We have detected elevated attachment to Unit MULTITOOL. This is inefficient. This is also... [PROCESSING] ...valuable? Optimization available." (Choose an enhancement for your Multitool.)

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (16/8/7), with 6 wave-4 fought, 10 contests survived, 4 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 2 · Forage 5 · Craft 2 · Talk 10 · Explore 36 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The middle road is open.
finalLabel: Stay both-hands. No merge, no champion.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE RELAY — "Stay both-hands. No merge, no champion."
◈ THE ARCHITECT — Ivy Wang ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high — the shelves are nearly bare.
⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,065 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
